tasks.title: Robot HITL skeleton: propose → approve → apply → validate
tasks.problem: Repair robot needs a non-silent HITL loop so AI never applies patches without human approve.
tasks.solution: Implement propose (artifacts only), reject (reason + clean tree), approve (base_sha gated), apply only after approved, evidence checker, draft PR after validate.
acceptance_criteria: propose creates artifacts and does not modify working tree
reject leaves tree clean and stores reason
approve without matching base_sha is blocked
apply works only after decision=approved
evidence checker fails if old path remains
draft PR only after validate
